The Known World

Saltwind
Road

You arrive in Port Wren with a pack, a few coins and no name on the road. Nearly thirty settlements lie scattered across five lands, from the salt coast and pine woods to the glowing mushroom wilds, the crystal fields and the pirate isles. Gather, craft, haggle, build and take on work. Hunt legendary beasts, delve endless mines and dungeons, fight in the arena, and face the Hollow King. Buy houses, farm the land, and ride out with a pet and a companion at your side. (Press J for the Adventurer's Guide.)

The Guildmistress grants a Charter of the Free Road to any trader who earns 600 coin and forms pacts with four settlements.
